vBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2318 (RUN-56 B0 re-plan): supervisor watchdog boot-grace period — the sole un-landed remainder after WI-1…WI-10 verified merged on origin/main

plan.title: Supervisor watchdog boot-grace period (remainder of PAN-2318 event-loop starvation work)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-4-8

narratives.Problem: After a dashboard deploy/restart the supervisor watchdog (src/supervisor/watchdog.ts) can restart a freshly-booting but alive dashboard. During Effect-layer bootstrap the HTTP listener may not be bound yet, so GET /api/health is connection-refused — a HARD failure (isTimeoutError=false). consecutiveHardFailures climbs and hardDown (>= failThreshold, default 3 → ~30s) triggers a 'dashboard unreachable' restart, which re-enters the same slow boot → churn. This is the PAN-1714 recurrence that on 2026-07-05 restarted the dashboard ~6 min after a deploy and removed the operator's ability to quickly stop agents. PAN-2219 added a post-restart PATROL-grace reset but nothing shields the hard-down (unreachable) path during a warming-up boot. All other PAN-2318 work (WI-1…WI-10) is already merged on origin/main (verified at code level) and is out of scope here.
narratives.Proposal: Add a boot-grace window to SupervisorWatchdog: while the dashboard has not yet answered GET /api/health OK since the watchdog started (or since the last watchdog-triggered restart), suppress the restart trigger, bounded by a configurable cap bootGraceMs (OVERDECK_SUPERVISOR_BOOT_GRACE_MS, default 300000). Grace ends at first successful health check, so a healthy server exits immediately and the cap only ever delays recovery of a never-responding boot. Each watchdog-triggered restart reseeds the window so the newly-spawned dashboard is also shielded, closing the churn loop. Counters keep climbing while deferring, so a genuinely-dead boot restarts the instant the cap elapses. Steady-state (post-first-healthy) restart behavior and the busy/timeout leash are unchanged.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do NOT re-implement WI-1…WI-10 (deacon extraction, event bridge, control surface, active-issue filter, planning-refresh gate, GitHub closed-window bound, /api/issues memoize+sort, EventRouter backoff, execSync eslint guard, event-loop gauge) — verified already merged on origin/main.
- Do NOT broaden into a general 'purge every sync read' sweep; residual sync reads (listOverdeckAgentStatesSync in read-model.ts, getReviewStatusSync in a few routes) stay as-is — file a separate follow-up if the FR-11 gauge later implicates them.
- Do NOT change steady-state (post-first-healthy) watchdog restart thresholds, the busy/timeout leash, or the deacon-patrol staleness assessment.
- Do NOT merge this branch ahead of PAN-2378 (operator: one cloister/supervisor-adjacent change in flight at a time).

autoDecisions.summary: Scoped beads to the un-landed remainder ONLY; created a single bead for the supervisor watchdog boot-grace period.
autoDecisions.rationale: Operator direction (RUN-56 B0) said to re-verify what landed and scope to the remainder. Code-level verification against origin/main showed WI-1…WI-10 all merged (all 6 new stream-1 files present; loadReadyForMergeFlags, closedWindowDays, getIssuesCache markers present). Re-planning merged work would be a regression risk and violate surgical-change discipline. The operator's one explicit new ask — the watchdog boot-grace — is verified absent in watchdog.ts, so it is the whole remainder.

autoDecisions.summary: Single-bead vBRIEF rather than splitting config/state/logic/tests.
autoDecisions.rationale: The change is one indivisible vertical tracer-bullet slice in a single file (~40 lines + tests). Splitting config-from-logic is a horizontal layer-slice the swarm contract rejects; splitting tests-from-code leaves a non-working intermediate. The whole slice lands, tests included, in a working state.

autoDecisions.summary: bootGraceMs default 300000 ms (5 min), env OVERDECK_SUPERVISOR_BOOT_GRACE_MS.
autoDecisions.rationale: Grace ends at first-healthy, so the cap only bounds a never-responding boot; a generous cap is low-risk. 5 minutes without any healthy /api/health response is a reasonable 'genuinely dead' threshold; operators with legitimately slower boots can raise the env var. Default lives in readWatchdogConfig alongside the other OVERDECK_SUPERVISOR_* defaults — no scattered hardcoded fallback.

autoDecisions.summary: Grace suppresses the entire restart trigger (both hardDown and busyStarved) while !hasBecomeHealthy.
autoDecisions.rationale: A warming-up server can present as connection-refused (hard) OR slow-to-answer (timeout); shielding only the hard path would leave a gap. Post-first-healthy the existing thresholds are untouched, so steady-state behavior is unchanged.

items.title: Add a boot-grace window to SupervisorWatchdog so a warming-up dashboard is not restarted as 'unreachable'

expected_outputs: src/supervisor/__tests__/watchdog.test.ts passes including the new boot-grace cases

narrative.Action: In src/supervisor/watchdog.ts implement the boot-grace window per PRD WI-11 (FR-12): (1) add bootGraceMs to SupervisorWatchdogConfig and parse OVERDECK_SUPERVISOR_BOOT_GRACE_MS in readWatchdogConfig via parsePositiveIntEnv (default 300000); (2) add hasBecomeHealthy:boolean and bootGraceStartedAt:number to InternalState, initialized in the constructor to false and this.now(); (3) set this.state.hasBecomeHealthy=true in runCheck's success branch (the `if (!restartReason)` block); (4) immediately before this.pruneRestartAttempts(startedAt), when restartReason is set, if !hasBecomeHealthy && startedAt - bootGraceStartedAt < bootGraceMs, log a 'deferring restart during boot grace' message, persistState(), and return WITHOUT restarting (do not reset counters); (5) after spawnRestart (alongside the existing PAN-2219 patrolUnhealthySince=null reset), set hasBecomeHealthy=false and bootGraceStartedAt=this.now() so the new boot is shielded. Use this.now() everywhere for the grace clock (never a bare Date.now) so the injected-now test harness stays deterministic. Then extend src/supervisor/__tests__/watchdog.test.ts with the boot-grace cases. Do not alter steady-state thresholds, the busy/timeout leash, or the deacon-patrol assessment.

items.title: Given the watchdog has never received a healthy /api/health response, when connection-refused failures reach failThreshold within bootGraceMs, then spawnRestart is NOT called and a log line stating the restart was deferred during boot grace is emitted.

Given the dashboard answers /api/health OK once (hasBecomeHealthy becomes true) and then hard-fails to failThreshold, when runCheck assesses the failure, then spawnRestart IS called — boot grace no longer applies after the first healthy check.

Given the dashboard has never been healthy and the injected clock has advanced past bootGraceMs, when the next hard failure is assessed, then spawnRestart IS called — a never-responding boot is not shielded past the cap.

Given the watchdog triggers a restart, when the newly-spawned dashboard is probed with refused connections within a fresh window, then those failures are deferred (hasBecomeHealthy reset to false and bootGraceStartedAt reseeded) rather than immediately restarting again.

Given OVERDECK_SUPERVISOR_BOOT_GRACE_MS is set to a value, when readWatchdogConfig parses env, then the returned config.bootGraceMs equals that value; and when it is unset, config.bootGraceMs defaults to 300000.
